about: Champions (docs/design/ARPG.md 5 lesson 8 and 7.1): named elites with affixes, read by logic/Content/Champions.cs and laid by Encounters (a beat's "champion" field, or a zone's "placed" one). A kit affix (kind set) casts that telegraph from data/content/telegraphs.json on its own cadence (every [min, max] s, the first firstAfter s after its pack wakes, its sizes x scale); every affix multiplies the foe's health, damage and speed. body (M5): an affix's tint and glow over its champion's, and rim (M5 r3): its hue in degrees, an emitted edge glow on its champion (the first affix's; none: looks.champion's rim, M5 r4), so it reads at night and in shade; raiser (M5 r3) is label-only (the Grave-Caller's raising is her kit), its line and rim alone; looks: a champion's and a captain's body over its kind's (scale, tint as r g b multipliers, glow), read before its plate; functional, L1 owns the final look. perTier: how many a rolled champion has at world tiers I-IV (a beat's count is its tier I count; a fixed list never grows). weight: how often a roll picks it. foes: a closing's ring, of its pack's first kind. The names and epithets are PLACEHOLDER copy for the story lead: a rolled title is "<name> <epithet>" when the epithet starts with "the", else "<name>, <epithet>".
